Title: TOM: Q: DS: Veiled Sight played for no effect?

Messages.Author: L. Scott Johnson
Messages.Body:
Tom,

Is it legal to play inferior Veiled Sight if the currently acting minion
is already at zero stealth? (Can you reduce zero to zero?)

Veiled Sight Reaction Chimerstry 2 blood
Normal: Only usable by a reacting minion who attempts to block the
acting minion. The acting minion's stealth is reduced to 0. After
this card is played, the acting minion may still increase his or
her stealth.
Superior: As above, and this reacting vampire may steal 1 blood from the
acting minion as a strike if combat begins.
Artist: Josh Timbrook
--
